entry.title: Docker 29 API Changes
entry.content:
In the latest Docker release, version 29, they increased the minimum API version which broken a lot of containers. The best thing to do for now is not update, but if like me you already did, you could either downgrade or just add the following to your docker.service file.

sudo systemctl edit docker.service

Add this part above the line ### Lines below this comment will be discarded:

[Service]
Environment=DOCKER_MIN_API_VERSION=1.24

Save and exit

sudo systemctl restart docker

This will force docker to use the old API version as it was before.
entry.summary: Docker 29 recently upgraded the minimum API version, which broke a lot of stuff

entry.title: Bypass Windows 11 Microsoft Account Requirement
entry.content:
Since the introduction of Windows 11, Microsoft haave forced users to create or login to a Microsoft account during a new installation. This can be very annoying if you don’t want a Microsoft account, or are setting up the computer for someone else, like we do everyday.

You used to be able open command prompt by using Shift+F10 (Shift+Fn+F10 on some laptops) and type the following command.

taskkill /F /IM oobenetworkconnectionflow.exe

Since 24H2 this no longer works, strangely I’ve found it works very occasionally.

The new method is as follows, don’t connect to any wireless network, if you have ethernet then just unplug the cable. When you get to the stage of being asked for a Microsoft account, open command, press Shift+F10 (Shift+Fn+F10 on some laptops) and type the following

start ms-cxh:localonly

this will bypass the online account and allow you to create a local user with or without a password.
entry.summary: Bypass the need for a Microsoft account during Windows 11 installation

entry.title: Retrofit Electric Folding Mirrors Renault Megane MK3

link.title: Retrofit Electric Folding Mirrors Renault Megane MK3

entry.content:
First of all, you need to check if you have the correct looms. Mine did but I’m not sure if all models do or only RS models. Take this panel off on both sides.

Now you can check the loom for the correct wire.

On the left, drivers side loom with the needed wire circled, and passenger side on the right.

If you have the correct loom then you just need to get new mirrors and the driver’s window switch controls.

Part number is 809610009R.

I’ve circled the pin you need to look for on each mirror to make sure they’re electric folding compared to a non-folding version.

On the left, drivers side mirror plug with the needed pin circled, and passenger side on the right.

Once you’ve swapped the mirrors it will require coding with either CLIP or DDT4ALL, I’ve not used CLIP so the tutorial will be with DDT.

You need to get a special adapter used on Fords as Renault and Ford share a OBD2 pinout. You can get them on eBay for around a tenner. Search Ford ELM327 on eBay and you should find a USB to OBD2 adapter.

Install DDT4ALL, link to the software and some databases.

I’m not going to go through a complete tutorial on how to use the software, if you need to learn then use this guy on YouTube, he’s not English but you can still follow along pretty easily.

You need to go to DDCM > Driver DCM X95 SLOT v4.0 > DCM Configuration > Write Configuration Select the correct options for your car and then press send

If you get an error that you need expert mode it’s the second option along the top, the weird black and white face and make sure your ignition is on but the engine is not.

I’m happy to help anyone if you can’t get it working, just send me an email at info@professorshroom.com.
entry.summary: Guide on retrofitting electric folding mirrors to Renault Megane MK3

entry.title: Update Renault Megane MK3 Radio to 2.42 (Latest Update)

link.title: Update Renault Megane MK3 Radio to 2.42 (Latest Update)

entry.content:
1. First you need a USB stick formatted to FAT32.
  2. Download this file and place it on the USB stick, make sure it’s the only file on it.
  3. Plug the USB stick into your car and make sure the radio is on. I would start to engine to make sure the ignition doesn’t turn off during the process.
  4. Switch the radio to FM mode.
  5. Open settings which is the bottom right button on the radio and navigate to Audio Settings > USB connection version > Display the software version.
  6. If it says anything other than “s2.42m2.42” then you need to update.
  7. Open settings which is the bottom right button on the radio and navigate to Audio Settings > USB connection version > Update Software.
  8. The update will take 1-2 minutes and then you’re done!
entry.summary: Update the Renault Megane MK3 radio/headunit to 2.42 which is the latest update
